title: Policy Orchestrator: region-aware retention validator + automated evidence bundles
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a Policy Orchestrator service that compiles policy-as-code rules into environment-specific validators and an evidence bundle generator. The orchestrator must: (1) validate region/data-residency tags and retention settings across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments; (2) detect config drift vs. policy baseline; (3) produce tamper-evident evidence bundles (audit-ready) and store them in a secure, queryable location; (4) execute low-risk automated remediation with configurable guardrails and human approval paths for high-risk changes. This ticket covers design, prototype, and an initial canary rollout for EU/US regions.
acceptance_criteria: Policy compilation pipeline converts policy-as-code rules (YAML/DSL) into validators for all target environments
Detector flags mismatches between deployed config and policy baseline with classification: transient|persistent|breaking
Evidence bundle includes: snapshot of effective config, diffs, evaluation logs, signer identity, timestamp, and S3/immutable store URI
Automated remediation runs for defined low-risk classes and records action in audit timeline; high-risk changes require a manual approval step
End-to-end test coverage with synthetic resources demonstrating detection -> bundle -> remediation flow
Console shows per-tenant policy drift dashboard and per-incident evidence link
technical_notes: Leverage existing policy-as-code repo and extend compiler to emit validators with region-aware assertions (e.g., enforce us-east storage for customer X)
Drift detector runs as event-driven service: when infra/config change events or daily scan schedule triggers; keep the detector idempotent and rate-limited
Evidence bundle format: JSONL with signed manifest; sign with KMS key per-org; store in compliance-buckets with lifecycle policy
Remediation engine supports dry-run and staged-rollout (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with ability to rollback
Provide REST API + internal SDK for Console and Automation playbooks to query incidents and fetch evidence
Plan for privacy: scrub PII from evidence bundles and include only config/assertion level details by default; full bundles available only to authorized auditors
tasks: Design policy DSL extensions for retention/residency assertions
Implement compiler changes to emit region-aware validators
Implement drift detector and scheduling logic
Design evidence bundle schema and signing workflow
Build remediation workflow with guardrails and approval hooks
Console: add drift incident list, evidence links, and remediation controls
Create e2e tests and synthetic fixtures for EU/US canary
Run security review and KMS provisioning for signing keys
